value.rationale: The truncated tetrahedron is a canonical smallest Archimedean polyhedral graph with S4 symmetry and two geometrically distinct face types. An explicit primitive integral basis by precisely six triangular-face pair and four opposite triangular–hexagonal face pair tori gives geometric meaning and a natural integral lattice, not merely computed Betti numbers. The nontrivial full S4-module and different rational homology for the S4 and A4 quotients supply concrete new equivariant information invisible to nonequivariant graph braid ranks.
